record.original_question: For a horizontal holomorphic period mapping Phi:S->D/T from an algebraic variety S to a quotient of a general period matrix domain, is the image S_Phi an algebraic variety such that Phi:S->S_Phi is an algebraic morphism and the canonical bundle on S_Phi is ample, thereby providing automorphic forms or algebraic projective embeddings analogous to the bounded symmetric domain case?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D$ be a period domain parametrizing polarized Hodge structures of a fixed weight and Hodge numbers on a polarized lattice, and let $\check D$ be its compact dual. Let $\Gamma \subset \mathrm{Aut}(D)$ be a discrete arithmetic monodromy group acting properly discontinuously on $D$, and form the analytic quotient $D/\Gamma$. Let $S$ be a smooth quasi-projective complex algebraic variety, and let \[ \Phi : S \longrightarrow D/\Gamma \] be a horizontal, locally liftable holomorphic period mapping (i.e., the local lifts to $D$ satisfy Griffiths transversality). Denote by $S_\Phi := \Phi(S) \subseteq D/\Gamma$ the image.

Prove or disprove the following:

(a) The image $S_\Phi$ carries the structure of a (quasi-projective) algebraic variety such that the induced map $\Phi : S \to S_\Phi$ is a morphism of algebraic varieties.

(b) On $S_\Phi$ there is a naturally defined canonical line bundle $K_{S_\Phi}$ (the descent of the Griffiths/Hodge-theoretic canonical bundle on $D$ to the quotient) that is ample, so that sufficiently high powers of its sections furnish a projective embedding of (a suitable compactification of) $S_\Phi$ — providing an analogue, for general period domains, of the automorphic forms and projective embeddings constructed for arithmetic quotients of bounded symmetric domains via the Baily–Borel theory.
artifact.status_search_result: Part (a), the algebraicity of period images and of the map $\Phi: S \to S_\Phi$, was established by Bakker, Brunebarbe and Tsimerman ("o-minimal GAGA and a conjecture of Griffiths", Invent. Math. 2023), settling Griffiths' algebraicity conjecture. Part (b) is partially resolved: Bakker, Brunebarbe and Tsimerman (2024/2025, "Baily–Borel compactifications of period images and the b-semiampleness conjecture", arXiv:2508.19215) construct a functorial projective compactification of $S_\Phi$ and prove that the Griffiths/Hodge bundle extends to a semiample line bundle, yielding an analogue of the Baily–Borel compactification. Full ampleness (rather than semiampleness) on the image and the complete construction of automorphic forms in the generality conjectured remain open in general.

status_evidence.title: o-minimal GAGA and a conjecture of Griffiths
status_evidence.snippet: Proves Griffiths' conjecture that images of period maps are quasi-projective algebraic varieties and the period maps are algebraic morphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Part (a), algebraicity of period images, is solved.

status_evidence.title: Baily–Borel compactifications of period images and the b-semiampleness conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a functorial projective compactification of the image of a period map for which the Griffiths bundle extends amply; in particular the Griffiths bundle is semiample.
status_evidence.claim: Part (b) is partially resolved: a Baily–Borel-type compactification exists and the Griffiths bundle is semiample.

status_evidence.title: Completion of Period Mappings and Ampleness of the Hodge Bundle (Green–Griffiths)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies ampleness properties of the augmented Hodge line bundle on completions of period mappings.
status_evidence.claim: Ampleness of the canonical/Hodge bundle on period images is an active subject with partial results.
